sources: https://book.wvstateparks.com/ supplier 11067522 (Greenbrier State Forest Electric Campsites), one-night and weekend stays read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Open spring through fall, weather permitting' (no dates published). The booking site sells nights from about April 20 through October 31: Tue 2027-04-13 and earlier none, Tue 2027-04-20 all 16 sites; Fri 2026-10-30 and Tue 2027-10-26 sold, Sun 2026-11-01 onward none.

season.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/greenbrier-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-greenbrier-state-forest/ ('The campground is open spring through fall, weather permitting.') + book.wvstateparks.com supplier 11067522 one-night stays 2026-10-30 (15 sites), 2026-11-01/02/03 (0), 2027-01-12 / 03-16 / 04-06 / 04-13 (0), 2027-04-20 (16), 2027-10-26 (16), 2027-11-02 (0), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every site (all electric) $44.99 a night on the WV State Parks booking site, weekday and weekend, spring through fall.

hookups.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/greenbrier-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-greenbrier-state-forest/ ('Electrical hookups') + booking site supplier 11067522 unit tags (20/30 Amp on all 16, 50 Amp on two of them), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 16 units for tents and trailers, all electric; five tagged pull-through; the booking site's RV-length class on most is 20-30 ft.

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/greenbrier-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-greenbrier-state-forest/ ('This 16-unit campground is fully equipped for both tents and trailers') + booking site supplier 11067522 (16 'Electric' units; Pull Thru Site on 5; 20'-30' RV class on 11), read 2026-10-21

values.note: On-site central bathhouse; fire pit and picnic table at each site, stone fireplace for grilling.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/greenbrier-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-greenbrier-state-forest/ ('On-site and central bathhouse', 'Fire pit', 'Picnic table', 'Stone fireplace for grilling out with family'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve online (WV State Parks booking site), by phone or at the campground office. Weekend (Friday and Saturday) reservations need both nights; one night Sunday-Thursday. The booking site does sell a one-night Friday close in (Fri 2026-10-30, nine days out) but not months ahead (Fri 2027-06-18: none).

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/greenbrier-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-greenbrier-state-forest/ ('Campsites may be reserved online at any time, by phone, or at the campground office.'; 'Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday, Saturday) or one night during the week (Sunday – Thursday)'; 'Visitors may book a maximum of 14 consecutive nights.') + booking site supplier 11067522 (one night Fri 2027-06-18: 0; Fri-Sat 2027-06-18/20: 15; one night Fri 2026-10-30: 15), read 2026-10-21
